verdict.summary: The workflow change correctly single-sources the archive feature set, adds a fail-closed nextest-list check that the feature-gated SIMD tests were built under the same workspace/target/features configuration as the archive, and verifies each execution runner exposes the x86_64 AVX2+FMA capabilities required for the dispatcher to exercise the audited intrinsic kernel. The relevant in-tree guard checks the real runtime dispatcher and fails under CI when AVX2 is unavailable; the audit register accurately describes that evidence. Quoting and shell failure handling are sound, and the filtered list is non-vacuous because it requires at least one literal simd::tests:: entry.
